Name: Lightroom Presets
Author: keelan182

Actions.Name: Apply Lightroom Preset
Actions.Tooltip: Applies a chosen Lightroom Desktop/CC develop preset to the currently selected photo.

Actions.Name: Refresh Lightroom Presets
Actions.Tooltip: Re-discovers presets from Lightroom Desktop/CC and updates every button's cached preset list.

Description: Assign Adobe Lightroom Desktop/CC develop presets to Stream Deck buttons and apply them to the selected photo instantly, via Lightroom's own External Controller API.
